Read a person-time column as days

Source: R/Input_ParticipantDays.R
ParticipantDayValues.Rd

A column that is not a number is an error, not a column of missing values. A study whose timeonstudy arrived as free text has not recorded zero days for everybody; it has recorded something this metric cannot read, and silently reading it as missing is the defect shape this rebuild removes.

Usage

ParticipantDayValues(vDays, strDayCol, strDomainName = "dfSubjects")

Arguments

vDays

Vector to read as person-time in days.

strDayCol

character Column name, for the message.

strDomainName

character Domain name, for the message.

Value

numeric of length(vDays), missing where the study recorded nothing.
